# Retired story workflow

The demo, recording, and publication workflow was removed on 2026-09-07.
It is no longer an executable or supported command set. Existing private
run directories and historical evidence were not deleted or republished.

For environment checks, simulator diagnostics, generators and network soak,
see [GUI and network debugging](../../Tools/Debug/README.md). Functional GUI
coverage remains in `AppTests` and `UITests`.
